Reference for the sample tool settings
Every option below can be set in the file or on the command line.
option default meaning
timeout 30 seconds before a request is cancelled
retries 3 attempts after a temporary failure
limit 100 largest number of items in one run
mode fast fast or careful processing
output result.json file that receives the answer
verbose off print every step to the console
cache on keep a copy of each reply on disk
format json json or plain text answer
settings = load_settings(path)
if settings.retries > 3:
    settings.retries = 3
for item in queue(limit=settings.limit):
    result = process(item, mode=settings.mode)
    write(result, settings.output)
code name action
E1 NoFile check the path
E2 Busy retry later
E3 TooLarge lower the limit
E4 Refused ask the owner
def retry(call, times):
    for n in range(times):
        try:
            return call()
        except TemporaryError:
            wait(n * 2)
    raise GiveUp()
